chuseongnal.definitionKo: 한국의 명절의 하나. 음력 8월 15일로 햅쌀로 빚은 송편과 햇과일 등의 음식을 장만하여 차례를 지낸다. 또한 씨름, 줄다리기, 강강술래 등의 민속놀이를 즐긴다.
chuseongnal.englishDescription: A traditional Korean holiday; it falls on the 15th day of the 8th month by the lunar calendar; on this day, people prepare special foods like songpyeon, half-moon rice cake, and newly harvested fruits, and hold a memorial service for their ancestors; they also enjoy a variety of folk games and plays such as ssireum, a traditional wrestling, juldarigi, tug-of-war, and ganggangsullae, a traditional circle dance.

clarity.englishDescription: A trait of a speech, a piece of writing, etc., that is clear and certain.
A quality of being clear and definite.
Clear enough to see the inside of an object.

clarity.definitionKo: 사람의 말이나 태도, 벌어진 상황 등이 분명함.
clarity.englishDescription: The state of a person's words, attitude, situation, etc., being clear.

clarity.definitionKo: 앞으로의 움직임이나 미래의 전망 등이 미리 짐작할 수 있게 분명함.
clarity.englishDescription: The state of upcoming developments, future outlook, etc., being clear, making it possible to guess in advance.

classroom.definitionKo: 유치원, 초등학교, 중학교, 고등학교에서 교사가 학생들을 가르치는 방.
classroom.englishDescription: In a kindergarten, elementary school, and secondary school, a room where a teacher teaches students.

cockpit.englishDescription: A seat where the pilot is seated.
A room where the pilot flies the aircraft.

coconut.definitionKo: 껍질이 단단하고 갈색의 털 같은 것으로 덮여 있는, 야자나무의 열매.
coconut.englishDescription: The fruit of a palm tree with a hard outer shell covered in brown hair-like things.

cohabitation.definitionKo: 결혼하지 않은 남녀가 부부처럼 한집에서 같이 삶.
cohabitation.englishDescription: The state of living together as husband and wife without getting married.

conceit.definitionKo: 자기에 관한 것을 스스로 자랑하며 잘난 체함.
conceit.englishDescription: The attitude of boasting about oneself and showing off.

conceit.definitionKo: 자기에 관한 것을 스스로 자랑하며 잘난 체하는 마음.
conceit.englishDescription: A feeling of wanting to show off things about oneself and be smug.

confusion.definitionKo: 갑자기 어떤 일을 당하여 정신을 못 차리고 어떻게 해야 할지를 몰라 함.
confusion.englishDescription: A state in which a person does not know what to do when he/she unexpectedly encounters a certain matter.

confusion.definitionKo: 어떤 체계의 질서나 사람의 마음을 뒤흔들어 어지럽게 함.
confusion.englishDescription: The act of disturbing the order of a system or a person's mind to cause confusion.

confusion.definitionKo: 정상적인 상태에서 벗어나거나 조화를 잃은 상태.
confusion.englishDescription: Being out of normal state or losing balance.

confusion.definitionKo: 도덕이나 질서가 제대로 지켜지지 않아 어지러움.
confusion.englishDescription: Confusion due to unobserved morals or order.

confusion.definitionKo: 해결할 방법을 찾을 수 없어 매우 혼란스러워하는 상태.
confusion.englishDescription: A state in which one feels extremely confused because one cannot find a solution.

confusion.definitionKo: 방향을 정하지 못하고 이쪽저쪽으로 왔다 갔다 함.
confusion.englishDescription: The act of going this way and that way without knowing where to go.

confusion.definitionKo: 어찌할 줄을 모르고 확실하게 결정을 하지 못함.
confusion.englishDescription: The state of hesitating to make a clear decision without knowing what to do.

confusion.definitionKo: 여러 가지가 한데 뒤섞여 어지럽고 복잡함.
confusion.englishDescription: A state of being mixed up to be chaotic and complicated.

confusion.definitionKo: 마구 뒤섞여서 구분이 되지 않고 규칙이나 질서가 없음. 또는 그런 상태.
confusion.englishDescription: A state of lacking rules or order with all things mixed up without being organized.

confusion.definitionKo: 서로 다른 것을 구별하지 못하고 뒤섞어서 생각함.
confusion.englishDescription: An act of mixing different things up without making a distinction between them.
A state of being mixed up to be chaotic without order.

confusion.definitionKo: 뒤죽박죽이 되어 어지럽고 질서가 없는 모양.
confusion.englishDescription: A state of being mixed up to become chaotic without order.
A state in which one's consciousness is fading away; or such a situation.

confusion.definitionKo: 정치와 사회가 불안정함. 또는 그런 상태.
confusion.englishDescription: A state in which a society and politics are not stable; or such a situation.

confusion.definitionKo: 말이나 일 등을 서로 다르게 이해하여 혼란이 생김.
confusion.englishDescription: A state of confusion arising from misunderstanding of words or a task, etc.

conglomerate.definitionKo: 자본이나 직원의 수가 많은, 큰 규모의 기업.
conglomerate.englishDescription: A large enterprise with many employees and a large amount of capital.

conglomerate.definitionKo: 경제 활동 분야에서, 커다란 자본과 강력한 힘을 가지고 있는 자본가나 기업가의 집단.
conglomerate.englishDescription: In business, a group of businessmen or financiers with a lot of capital and significant power.

conservatism.definitionKo: 새로운 것이나 변화를 반대하고 전통적인 것을 따르고 지키려는 성향.
conservatism.englishDescription: The inclination to oppose new things or changes and to follow and stick to traditional things.

conservatism.definitionKo: 새로운 것이나 변화를 적극적으로 받아들이기보다는 전통적인 제도나 방법을 그대로 지키려고 하는 사고방식이나 태도.
conservatism.englishDescription: A way of thinking or attitude that seeks to maintain traditional systems or methods rather than actively accepting new things or changes.

conservatism.definitionKo: 옛 제도나 풍습을 그대로 지키고 따름.
conservatism.englishDescription: The act of keeping and following the old systems and customs.

continously.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of blowing one's breath on something continuously.

convergence.definitionKo: 여럿으로 나뉘어 있는 의견이나 생각 등을 하나로 모음.
convergence.englishDescription: A merging of divided opinions, ideas, etc., into one.

copyright.definitionKo: 창작물에 대해 저작자나 그 권리를 이어받은 사람이 가지는 권리.
copyright.englishDescription: The right to a work held by its author or a person who has inherited such a right.

copyright.definitionKo: 저작권법에 의해 저작권을 가진 사람과 계약하여 도서, 영상 매체 등의 출판이나 제작에 관한 이익을 독점하는 권리.
copyright.englishDescription: The right to exclusively take the profits from publishing or producing a book, video, etc., through a contract with a copyright holder, according to copyright law.

coterie.definitionKo: 목적이나 뜻을 같이하여 모인 사람. 또는 그런 사람들의 모임.
coterie.englishDescription: People who gather with the same purpose or will, or the meeting of such people.

crafts.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 손으로 직접 만드는 일.
crafts.englishDescription: The act of making something manually.

curd.definitionKo: 우유나 반죽 등의 속에 둥글게 엉긴 덩이.
curd.englishDescription: A round, coagulated mass inside milk or dough, etc.

curd.definitionKo: 우유나 반죽 등의 속에 작고 둥글게 엉긴 덩이.
curd.englishDescription: A round, conagulated mass inside milk or dough, etc.

daeya.definitionKo: 주로 세수할 때 물을 담아 쓰는 둥글고 넓적한 그릇.
daeya.englishDescription: A wide and round bowl where a person fills water to wash his/her face.

danglingly.definitionKo: 위태롭게 매달려 힘들게 붙어 있는 모양.
danglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the state of something hanging dangerously.

danglingly.definitionKo: 작은 물체가 가볍게 매달려 자꾸 흔들리는 모양.
danglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the movement of a small hanging object swaying gently and repeatedly.

danglingly.definitionKo: 큰 방울이나 매달린 물체 등이 한 번 흔들리는 모양.
danglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the movement of a big bell, hanging object, etc., swaying.

danglingly.definitionKo: 큰 방울이나 매달린 물체 등이 자꾸 흔들리는 모양.
danglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the movement of a big bell, hanging object, etc., swaying repeatedly.

defecate.englishDescription: To discharge urine or excrement from the body.

degrade.englishDescription: To lower a grade or level.

degrade.definitionKo: 자격이나 등급, 지위 등이 낮아지다. 또는 그렇게 하다.
degrade.englishDescription: For authority, grade, position, etc., to be lowered; or to lower it.

degrade.definitionKo: 권리나 인격 또는 위엄 등을 해치거나 떨어뜨리다.
degrade.englishDescription: To damage or drop someone's right, personality, dignity, etc.
To lower the degree or level of something.

degrade.definitionKo: 올바른 길에서 벗어나 나쁜 길로 빠지다.
degrade.englishDescription: To become corrupt, deviate from the right way.
To do damage to something by destroying or breaking it.

depositing.definitionKo: 돈이나 물건을 은행이나 기관 등에 맡겨 둠.
depositing.englishDescription: The act of keeping money or an object in a bank, institution, etc.

depositing.definitionKo: 은행 등의 금융 기관에 돈이나 주식, 물건 등을 부탁하여 맡김.
depositing.englishDescription: The act of keeping money, stocks, an object, etc., in a financial institution such as a bank.

descendent.englishDescription: A child who will continue the line of a family.

development.definitionKo: 토지나 천연자원 등을 이용하기 쉽거나 쓸모 있게 만듦.
development.englishDescription: The act of making land, natural resources, etc. useful, or easy to utilize.

development.definitionKo: 능력이나 지식 등을 더 나아지게 함.
development.englishDescription: The act of improving one's ability, knowledge, etc.

development.definitionKo: 한 나라의 경제나 특정 분야의 산업을 더 나아지게 하거나 커지게 함.
development.englishDescription: The act of improving or expanding the economy of a nation or a certain industry.

development.definitionKo: 새로운 물건을 만들거나 새로운 생각을 내놓음.
development.englishDescription: The act of creating a new product or idea.

development.definitionKo: 지능이나 재능, 사상 등을 일깨워 발전시킴.
development.englishDescription: Awaking and developing one's IQ, talent, thought, etc.

development.definitionKo: 일이 진행되는 과정.
development.englishDescription: The process through which a certain work goes on.

development.definitionKo: 일이 진행되는 상황이나 진행된 결과.
development.englishDescription: The situation of something developing or the developed result.

development.definitionKo: 사람이 꾸준히 노력을 하거나 경험을 쌓아 발전된 모습으로 자람.
development.englishDescription: The state of a person growing into an advanced being through continuous efforts or accumulated experiences.

development.definitionKo: 사물의 규모나 세력 등이 점점 커짐.
development.englishDescription: The state of the size, power, etc., of an object becoming bigger gradually.

development.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 상황이 지금보다 좋은 상태로 나아감.
development.englishDescription: The process of developing a matter or situation to a better state.

development.definitionKo: 생물체가 자라남.
development.englishDescription: The growth of an organism.

development.definitionKo: 발전한 모습.
development.englishDescription: The state or status of something having made progress or achieved development.

development.definitionKo: 인격이나 실력, 능력 등이 자라도록 가르치고 키움.
development.englishDescription: The act of teaching and raising someone to develop his/her personality, ability, skill, etc.

development.definitionKo: 문물의 발전 정도.
development.englishDescription: The level of development of culture.

development.definitionKo: 생물이 나서 자람. 또는 그런 과정.
development.englishDescription: The growth of an organism, or such a process.

development.definitionKo: 몸과 마음을 단련해서 품성이나 지식, 도덕 등을 기름.
development.englishDescription: Training your body and mind to cultivate character, knowledge, and morals.

development.definitionKo: 더 좋은 상태나 더 높은 단계로 나아감.
development.englishDescription: The act of moving forward to a better state or higher step.

development.definitionKo: 신체, 정서, 지능 등이 성장하거나 성숙함.
development.englishDescription: The process of becoming bigger, better in one's body, emotion, intelligence, etc.

development.definitionKo: 학문, 기술, 문명, 사회 등의 현상이 보다 높은 수준에 이름.
development.englishDescription: The process of reaching a higher level in a phenomenon such as academics, technology, civilization, society, etc.

development.definitionKo: 어떤 것의 세력이나 규모 등이 점차 커짐.
development.englishDescription: A gradual growth of the power, size, etc., of something.

development.definitionKo: 일이나 사물 등이 점점 발달해 감.
development.englishDescription: A state in which a matter, thing, etc., is gradually developed.

development.definitionKo: 바로 섬. 또는 바로 세움.
development.englishDescription: The act of standing or causing to stand upright.

development.definitionKo: 무엇을 만들어서 이룸.
development.englishDescription: The act of making and establishing something.

development.definitionKo: 정도나 수준이 나아지거나 높아짐.
development.englishDescription: The act of moving forward to a better state or higher level.

development.definitionKo: 어떤 것이 걸리거나 막히는 것 없이 쑥쑥 뻗어 나감. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
development.englishDescription: The state of growing without hindrance or blockage, or an act of making something grow in such a way.

development.definitionKo: 시간이 지나면서 일이나 상황이 변함. 또는 그 변하는 모습.
development.englishDescription: The state of an incident or situation changing over time, or such a change.

development.definitionKo: 지식이나 능력, 성품 등을 기르고 닦음.
development.englishDescription: An act of developing and building up one's knowledge, ability, or personality, etc.

development.definitionKo: 어떤 모습이나 모양을 갖춤.
development.englishDescription: A state of developing or acquiring a certain character or form.

diarrhea.definitionKo: 장에서 음식물을 소화하는 데에 이상이 생겨 물기가 많은 똥을 눔. 또는 그런 똥.
diarrhea.englishDescription: The state of having liquid bowel movements due to a disturbance in one's intestines' ability to digest food, or such stools.

diarrhea.definitionKo: 장에서 음식물을 소화하는 데에 이상이 생겨 물기가 많은 똥을 누는 병.
diarrhea.englishDescription: A disease in which one has liquid bowel movements due to a disturbance in one's instestines' ability to digest food.

dirtiness.definitionKo: 깨끗하지 않은 것. 혹은 깨끗하던 것이 더러워지는 것.
dirtiness.englishDescription: The state of not being clean or a clean thing becoming dirty.

dirtiness.definitionKo: 어떤 사물이나 장소가 깨끗하지 않고 더러움.
dirtiness.englishDescription: A thing or place being dirty, not clean.

dishonor.definitionKo: 사람들로부터 높은 평가나 좋은 평판을 받지 못함.
dishonor.englishDescription: The state of getting a bad reputation or losing respect from people.

document.definitionKo: 다른 일의 자료가 되거나 어떤 사실을 증명하는 데 쓰이는 글을 적은 종이.
document.englishDescription: Paper with information in writing to be used for something or as proof to verify a fact.

document.definitionKo: 옛날의 제도나 문물을 아는 데 증거가 되는 자료나 기록.
document.englishDescription: Material or record that serves as  evidence for understanding an institution or culture of the past.
To record something as a document.

document.definitionKo: 주로 후일에 남길 목적으로 어떤 사실이나 생각을 적거나 영상으로 남기다.
document.englishDescription: To write down or record on video a certain fact or thought, usually to hand down for the future.

doll.englishDescription: A toy made in the form of a person or an animal.

domesticate.definitionKo: 사람이 짐승을 잘 따르게 가르쳐서 부리기 좋게 하다.
domesticate.englishDescription: To teach people to follow animals well and make them easy to use.

drilling.definitionKo: 석유 등의 지하자원이 있는지 알아보거나 지층의 구조나 상태를 조사하기 위해 기계로 땅속 깊이 구멍을 뚫는 일.
drilling.englishDescription: The act of making a deep underground hole with a machine in order to find out whether or not there are underground resources such as oil, etc., or investigate the structure or state of the stratum.

drizzle.definitionKo: 바람이 없는 날 소리 없이 가늘게 내리는 비.
drizzle.englishDescription: Fine rain that falls quietly on a day without wind.

drizzle.definitionKo: 바람이 없는 날 소리 없이 조금씩 내리는 비.
drizzle.englishDescription: Fine rain which falls quietly on a day without wind.
Streaks of rain as fine as threads.

drug.definitionKo: 병이나 상처 등을 고치거나 예방하기 위하여 먹거나 바르거나 주사하는 물질.
drug.englishDescription: A substance consumed, applied, or injected to treat or prevent a disease or wound, etc.

drug.definitionKo: 병이나 상처 등을 낫게 하거나 예방하기 위하여 먹거나 바르거나 주사하는 물질.
drug.englishDescription: A substance orally administered, applied or injected to treat or prevent an illness, wound, etc.
(figurative) A narcotic drug or alcoholic beverage.

duckweed.definitionKo: 연못이나 논 위에 떠서 사는 타원형의 작은 초록색 풀.
duckweed.englishDescription: A small green, oval grass which floats on a pond or rice paddy.

duckweed.definitionKo: 몸이 겉은 풀색이고 안은 자주색인 세 개의 둥근 잎으로 이루어져 있고, 논이나 연못의 물 위에 떠서 자라는 풀.
duckweed.englishDescription: A plant that floats on the water of a rice paddy or pond; it has three round leaves that are grass green on the outside and purple on the inside.

ear.definitionKo: 남이 하는 말의 뜻을 알아듣는 능력.
ear.englishDescription: The ability to understand the meaning of what others say.

ear.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물의 머리 양옆에 있어 소리를 듣는 몸의 한 부분.
ear.englishDescription: The part of a human or animal's body that hears sounds, located on both sides of the head.

ear.definitionKo: 귀ㆍ눈ㆍ입ㆍ코. 또는 귀ㆍ눈ㆍ입ㆍ코를 중심으로 한 얼굴의 생김새.
ear.englishExpression: ear, eye, mouth, and nose; features
ear.englishDescription: One's ears, eyes, mouth, and nose, or one's looks based on the ears, eyes, mouth, and nose.

ear.definitionKo: 벼나 보리 등의 곡식에서, 꽃이 피고 열매가 열리는 부분.
ear.englishDescription: A part of rice, barley, etc., where a flower opens and fruit comes into bearing.

easy-to-handle.englishDescription: Light and easy to lift or handle.

eek.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is startled.

eek.definitionKo: 놀랐을 때 자기도 모르게 지르는 소리.
eek.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered despite oneself when the speaker is surprised.

eek.definitionKo: 매우 아프거나 힘들거나 놀라거나 기막힐 때 내는 소리.
eek.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is very achy, exhausted, surprised, or stunned.

eek.definitionKo: 매우 심하게 아프거나 힘들거나 놀라거나 기막힐 때 내는 소리.
eek.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is very severely aching, exhausted, surprised, or stunned.

eek.definitionKo: 갑자기 놀라거나 쓰러질 때 내는 소리.
eek.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is surprised or falls suddenly.

eek.definitionKo: 자신이 놀랐을 때, 또는 남을 놀라게 할 때 크게 지르는 소리.
eek.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered loudly when the speaker is surprised or surprises someone.

efficient.definitionKo: 일정한 시간 동안 할 수 있는 일이 많은.

moan.definitionKo: 몹시 아프거나 힘이 들어 괴로워하며 자꾸 소리를 내다.
moan.englishDescription: To make painful sounds when one experiences a sharp pain.

mozambique.definitionKo: 아프리카 대륙의 남동부에 있는 나라. 주요 생산물로는 목화, 땅콩 등이 있다. 공용어는 포르투갈어, 스와힐리어이고 수도는 마푸투이다.
mozambique.englishDescription: A country located in the southeast of Africa as a major producer of cotton, peanut, etc.; its official language is Portuguese and Swahili, and its captial is Maputo.

mud.definitionKo: 땅이 물기가 많아 질퍽질퍽하게 된 곳.
mud.englishDescription: An area of wet, muddy, sloppy ground.

mud.definitionKo: 빛깔이 붉고 물기가 있어 잘 들러붙는 흙.
mud.englishDescription: Soil that is sticky and red because it contains a large amount of water.

mud.definitionKo: 흙이 물기가 매우 많아 몹시 질게 된 땅.
mud.englishDescription: Soil that is deep and slimy because it contains a large amount of water.

mud.definitionKo: 바닷물 등에서 흙과 작고 더러운 물질이 썩어 생기는 냄새나는 찌꺼기.
mud.englishDescription: Stinky residue that forms by the decaying of soil and small, dirty substances in seawater, etc.

mullet.definitionKo: 등이 푸르며 배는 하얗고 몸에 둥근 비늘이 덮여 있는, 강 하구나 연안에 사는 물고기.
mullet.englishDescription: A round-scaled fish with a blue back and white belly that lives in a river mouth or near-shore water.

murder.englishDescription: The act of killing a person.
An act of killing a person.

murder.definitionKo: 부모나 대통령, 임금 등의 지위가 높은 사람을 죽임.
murder.englishDescription: An act of killing a high-ranking person such as a parent, president, king, etc.

murder.definitionKo: 부모나 대통령, 임금 등의 지위가 높은 사람을 죽이다.
murder.englishDescription: To kill a person of a high position such as a parent, the president, king, etc.

myeolchijorim.definitionKo: 멸치에 양념한 국물을 넣고 국물이 거의 없어질 때까지 끓여서 만든 반찬.
myeolchijorim.englishDescription: A side dish made by braising anchovies in water, soy sauce and other seasonings.

nap.definitionKo: 종이나 천 등에 부풀어 일어나는 몹시 가는 털의 낱개.
nap.englishDescription: A fine, fuzzy piece of fiber that rises on paper, cloth, etc.

nap.definitionKo: 물건의 거죽에 부풀어 일어난 가는 실 모양의 물질.
nap.englishDescription: A thin thread-like substance that swells up on the surface of an object.

narrow-minded.definitionKo: 오래된 생각이나 방식에 익숙하여 새로운 것이나 변화를 받아들이지 않다.
narrow-minded.englishDescription: Sticking to old thoughts or methods and being reluctant to accept new ones.
Not generous and having a narrow view of things.

narrow-minded.definitionKo: 사람됨이나 생각 등이 좁고 훌륭하지 않다.
narrow-minded.englishDescription: (for character, thoughts, etc.) Narrow and not great.
One's thoughts or personality being not generous or broad.

narrow-minded.definitionKo: 한쪽으로 치우쳐 생각이나 마음이 좁고 너그럽지 못하다.
narrow-minded.englishDescription: One's thought or mind being petty and not generous, as it is biased.
Showing a narrow viewpoint or attitude toward something.

newsroom.definitionKo: 방송국이나 신문사 등에서 새로운 소식을 알리는 일을 맡은 부서.
newsroom.englishDescription: A department in charge of reporting news in a broadcasting station, newspaper, etc.

niggardly.definitionKo: 물건이나 돈 등을 몹시 아껴 씀씀이가 너그럽지 못하다.
niggardly.englishDescription: Not generous in spending things, money, etc.

nitrogen.definitionKo: 상온에서 기체 상태로 존재하며 공기의 약 78%를 이루는, 색깔이나 냄새, 맛이 없는 원소.
nitrogen.englishDescription: An element that constitutes nearly 78% of the air, occurring as a colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas at room temperature.

nohyeong.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 처음 만났거나 그리 가깝지 않은 남자 어른들 사이에서 상대방을 가리키는 말.
nohyeong.englishDescription: (polite form) A pronoun used by male adults to indicate the other person, when they are not well acquainted or not that close.

nutriment.definitionKo: 탄수화물, 단백질, 비타민 등 생물의 성장과 에너지 공급을 위한 영양분이 들어 있는 물질.
nutriment.englishDescription: A substance such as a carbohydrate, a protein, or a vitamin which has nutritive elements for the growth and energy of a living thing.
An element that nourishes one's body.

nutriment.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 정신의 성장이나 발전에 도움을 주는 정보, 지식, 사상 등.
nutriment.englishDescription: (figurative) Information, knowledge, ideas, etc., that are helpful to one's mental growth or development.

nyeondae.definitionKo: 그 단위의 첫 해로부터 다음 단위로 넘어가기 전까지의 기간.
nyeondae.englishDescription: A bound noun used to refer to the time from the first year of a 10, 100, or 1000-year-period to the year before moving over to the next period.

omen.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 일어나려고 하는 움직임이나 분위기.
omen.englishDescription: A movement or atmosphere that signals something is going to happen.

omen.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 일어날 것 같은 분위기나 느낌.
omen.englishDescription: A vibe or feeling that makes one think something may happen.

omen.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 일어날 것 같은 분위기나 느낌.
omen.englishDescription: An atmosphere or feeling that suggests something is likely to happen.

omen.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 일어났거나 일어날 것을 나타내는 현상.
omen.englishDescription: Something that indicates that something happened or is likely to happen.

onlooking.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 직접 나서지 않고 옆에서 바라보기만 하는.
onlooking.englishDescription: Just looking at a certain incident on the sideline, rather than stepping forward to handle it.

onlooking.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 직접 나서지 않고 옆에서 바라보기만 하는 것.
onlooking.englishDescription: A state in which one observes something without taking part in it.

onlooking.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 직접 나서지 않고 옆에서 바라보기만 함.
onlooking.englishDescription: An act of observing something without taking part in it.

operational.englishDescription: Being associated with the actual handling of work.

opportunely.definitionKo: 어떤 기회나 경우에 딱 맞게 우연히.
opportunely.englishDescription: By chance, in the manner of being perfectly good for a certain opportunity or moment.

ordinance.definitionKo: 지방 자치 단체가 그 지방의 사무와 관련하여 지방 의회의 회의를 거쳐 정한 법.
ordinance.englishDescription: A law enacted by a local government in connection with municipal affairs after clearing the council.

oversee.definitionKo: 일이나 상황에 대해 관심을 가지고 두루 살피다.
oversee.englishDescription: To pay attention to a certain project or situation and look over its progress.

oversee.definitionKo: 일이나 사람이 잘못되지 않도록 살피고 단속하다.
oversee.englishDescription: To monitor and enforce rules to promote work or to prevent those working from getting off task.
To lead and superintend a person or people.

paradise.definitionKo: 불교에서, 악한 것과 괴로움이 없으며 매우 편안하고 자유로운 세계.
paradise.englishDescription: In Buddhism, a very comfortable  world free from evil or suffering.

paradise.definitionKo: 매우 편안하여 아무 걱정이 없는 상태나 그러한 장소.
paradise.englishDescription: A state of feeling very comfortable without any worries, or such a place.

paradise.definitionKo: 아무 걱정이나 고통 없이 행복하게 살 수 있는 곳.
paradise.englishDescription: A place where people exist happily with no worry or pain.

paradise.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 행복하고 즐겁게 살 수 있는 곳.
paradise.englishDescription: (figurative) A place where one can enjoy and live a happy life.

paradise.definitionKo: 불교에서, 악한 것과 괴로움이 없으며 매우 편안하고 자유로운 세계.
paradise.englishDescription: In Buddhism, a very comfortable world free from evil or suffering.

paradise.definitionKo: 아무런 걱정이나 고통 없이 행복하고 즐겁게 살 수 있는 곳.
paradise.englishDescription: A place where people exist happily with no worry or pain.

paradise.definitionKo: 기독교에서 하나님이 다스리며 예수를 믿은 사람이 죽은 후에 갈 수 있다는 곳.
paradise.englishDescription: In Christianity, a place governed by God, where people who believe in Jesus can go after death.

pathological.definitionKo: 말이나 행동 등이 정상적인 상태에서 벗어나 지나친.
pathological.englishDescription: One's words or behavior being too excessive to be considered normal.

penance.definitionKo: 불교에서, 몸으로 견디기 어려운 일들을 통하여 수행을 쌓는 일.
penance.englishDescription: In Buddhism, an act of making oneself suffer physically, with an intention to suppress one's desire and find illumination.

perfect.definitionKo: 부족한 점이 없이 모든 것이 다 갖추어져 있다.
perfect.englishDescription: Everything being provided without anything left out.

perfect.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 있어서 매우 조심하여 부족함이 없이 완벽하다.
perfect.englishDescription: Being complete without flaws because one is very careful about something.
Perfect or accurate without any flaw.
Well qualified for a certain task.
Being complete without flaws or defects.

pigsty.englishDescription: A place for confining and raising pigs.

planet.definitionKo: 중심 별이 강하게 끌어당기는 힘 때문에 타원형의 궤도를 그리며 중심 별의 주위를 도는 천체.
planet.englishDescription: A celestial body revolving around a central star in elliptical orbits due to the pulling force from the star.

planet.definitionKo: 중심 별이 강하게 끌어당기는 힘 때문에 타원형의 궤도를 그리며 중심 별의 주위를 도는 천체.
planet.englishDescription: A celestial body revolving around a central star in elliptical orbits due to the pulling force from the star.

poach.englishDescription: To entice someone to leave a group.
To catch an animal or fish.

politeness.englishDescription: The quality or state of having nice manners and being modest.

politeness.definitionKo: 사람이 당연히 지켜야 할 바른 마음가짐과 태도.
politeness.englishDescription: Good mental attitude and manners that a person should keep.

prequel.definitionKo: 두 편으로 나뉘어 있는 책이나 영화 등의 앞쪽 편.
prequel.englishDescription: The earlier part of a book, movie, etc., that is divided into two parts.

pretend.englishDescription: To fabricate one's behavior or attitude.

pretend.definitionKo: 이름, 직업, 나이, 주소 등을 거짓으로 속여 말하다.
pretend.englishDescription: To make a false statement about one's name, job, age, address, etc., to deceive someone.
(figurative) To plot something in order to deceive another person.

pretend.definitionKo: 어떤 모양이나 동작을 실제로 하는 것처럼 흉내 내다.
pretend.englishDescription: To fake a certain gesture or action as if one is actually doing it.

pretend.definitionKo: 앞에 오는 말이 뜻하는 모양을 하고 있음을 나타내는 말.
pretend.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used to indicate that something acts in accordance with something mentioned in the preceding statement.

pretend.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 거짓을 사실인 것처럼 보이게 하기 위해 말이나 행동을 꾸며 내다.
pretend.englishDescription: To say or do a speech or act to another person for him/her to believe something fake as real.

pretend.definitionKo: 앞말이 뜻하는 행동이나 상태를 거짓으로 꾸밈을 나타내는 말.
pretend.englishDescription: An auxiliary verb used to indicate that one is pretending to do something or to be something.

pretend.definitionKo: 앞말이 뜻하는 행동이나 상태를 거짓으로 꾸밈을 나타내는 말.
pretend.englishDescription: An auxiliary verb used to indicate that one is pretending to do something or to be something.
To fabricate one's emotion or expression.

pretend.definitionKo: 사실은 그렇지 않은 사람이 어떤 당사자인 것처럼 꾸미어 행동하다.
pretend.englishDescription: To fake one's identity, passing oneself off as someone else.

prince.englishDescription: A word of endearment used to refer to or address a boy.

prince.definitionKo: 왕위가 이어지는 나라에서, 나라를 다스리는 가장 높은 자리에 있는 사람.
prince.englishDescription: The person who is in the highest position of power in a country where the crown is passed down from one to another member of the royal family.

prince.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 각 분야에서 매우 뛰어난 사람. 또는 많이 쓰이는 물건.
prince.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who is very outstanding in each field; or an object used by many people.
A son of the emperor, who will be the next emperor.

protrudingly.englishDescription: In a state in which the tip of something protrudes sharply.
In the state of being swollen or sticking out a little.

protrudingly.definitionKo: 평평한 표면에 여럿이 다 끝이 길게 튀어나와 있는 모양.
protrudingly.englishDescription: In a state in which all the tips of several things are protruding on a level surface.

protrudingly.definitionKo: 물체의 끝부분이 조금 길게 나와 있는 모양.
protrudingly.englishDescription: In the state of the tip of something protruding quite far.

protrudingly.definitionKo: 물체의 끝부분이 조금 길게 나와 있는 모양.
protrudingly.englishDescription: In the state of the tip of something protruding quite far.

protrudingly.definitionKo: 물건의 끝이 조금씩 가늘어지면서 삐죽하게 솟은 모양.
protrudingly.englishDescription: In the manner of an object growing thinner and pointed toward the end as it sticks out.

protrudingly.definitionKo: 물건의 끝이 조금씩 가늘어지면서 삐죽삐죽하게 솟은 모양.
protrudingly.englishDescription: In the manner of an object growing thinner and pointed toward the end as it sticks out.

pudakgeorihada.definitionKo: 간단하게 음식을 차려 놓고 무당이 굿을 하여 불길한 일이나 나쁜 귀신을 쫓다.
pudakgeorihada.englishDescription: perform an exorcism: For mudang, a female shaman, to perform gut, an exorcism, with some food, to prevent an ominous event or expel evil spirits from a certain place.

puddle.definitionKo: 땅이 아래로 우묵하게 파여 물이 모여 있는 곳.
puddle.englishDescription: A hollow area in the ground, where water gathers.

radeunji.definitionKo: 어느 것이 선택되어도 상관없는 대상을 예를 들거나 열거함을 나타내는 조사.
radeunji.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used when giving an example of, or listing things in which the choice of any one does not matter.

rampage.definitionKo: 어떤 목적을 이루기 위해 미친 듯이 날뜀.
rampage.englishDescription: The act of rampaging about in order to accomplish an aim.
(figurative) To mushroom all over the place, disrupting the order.

rapping.definitionKo: 단단한 물체를 자꾸 치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
rapping.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the act of hitting a hard object repeatedly.

re-checkup.definitionKo: 한 번 검사한 것을 다시 검사함.
re-checkup.englishDescription: The act of inspecting again what has already been inspected.

reactionism.definitionKo: 진보나 개혁 또는 혁신의 움직임을 반대하거나 가로막는 성질.
reactionism.englishDescription: The quality of opposing or impeding progressive, reformist or innovative movements.

reactionism.definitionKo: 자기 나라의 전통문화만을 중요하게 생각하고 외국의 것은 거부하는 사고방식.
reactionism.englishDescription: A mindset of thinking highly of one's own traditional culture while rejecting foreign elements.

rebellion.definitionKo: 나라 안에서 정부에 대항하거나 정권을 잡으려고 벌이는 큰 싸움.
rebellion.englishDescription: A big struggle within a nation where insurgents rebel against the government or attempt to take control.
Causing a major disruption in society.
A big disturbance within a nation.
An uprising against the government or sovereign.

rebellion.definitionKo: 정부나 지도자 등에 반대하여 공격하거나 싸움을 일으킴.
rebellion.englishDescription: The act of starting a fight against or attacking a government or its leaders as a way of opposing them.

rebellion.definitionKo: 국가와 민족, 또는 그와 비슷한 권력을 가진 조직을 다스리는 지배자의 권한을 빼앗으려고 함.
rebellion.englishDescription: An act of seizing power from a person who rules a nation, people or any organization that has a similar power.

rebellion.definitionKo: 다른 사람이나 대상에 맞서 달려들거나 부딪힘.
rebellion.englishDescription: The act of confronting, attacking or colliding with another person or object.

recording.definitionKo: 소리를 테이프나 시디 등의 기계 장치에 기록함. 또는 그렇게 기록한 소리.
recording.englishDescription: The act of recording sounds on tapes or CDs using a machine, or the recorded sound.

refereeing.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서, 규칙을 지키고 어기는 것이나 승부를 가려내는 사람. 또는 그런 일.
refereeing.englishDescription: A person who judges who wins or loses, and whether a rule has been violated or not in a sports game; such a job.

relaxed.englishDescription: Keeping one's composure and not hurrying.
Having no tension in the mind.

relaxed.definitionKo: 시간이나 공간, 돈 등이 넉넉하여 남음이 있다.
relaxed.englishDescription: Being a state in which there is abundant time, space, money, etc., enough to spare.
Having time to spare without haste.

renovate.englishDescription: To fix something to make new or to change it.

renovate.definitionKo: 나쁜 관습이나 낡은 사상 등을 버리고 새롭게 하다.
renovate.englishDescription: To throw away bad customs, old ideas, etc., and make new ones.

renovate.definitionKo: 도로나 시설이 제 기능을 하도록 정리하다.
renovate.englishDescription: To fix roads or facilities to make them serve their purpose.

renovate.definitionKo: 오래된 건물의 낡고 헌 부분을 손질하여 고치다.
renovate.englishDescription: To tend to and fix the old, worn-out parts of an age-old building.

reprint.definitionKo: 한 번 출판했던 책을 다시 출판함. 또는 그렇게 출판한 책.
reprint.englishDescription: The act of publishing again a book that has already been published, or a book published that way.

resources.englishDescription: Energy or effort that is required to perform a certain task or job.

restaurant.englishDescription: A business cooking and selling food.

restaurant.definitionKo: 건물 안에 식사를 할 수 있게 만든 방.
restaurant.englishDescription: A place for eating meals within a building.
A store where food is made and served.
A restaurant that sells western food.
A place where a variety of dishes and beverages are sold.

saengida.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 부정적인 상황에 이르게 됨을 나타내는 말.
saengida.englishDescription: An auxiliary adjective used when reaching a negative situation mentioned in the preceding statement.

safari.definitionKo: 야생 동물을 가두어 놓지 않고 기르는 공원에 자동차를 타고 다니며 차 안에서 그 야생 동물을 구경하는 일.
safari.englishDescription: Driving to a park where wild animals are kept out of captivity and watching the wild animals from inside the car.

safeguard.englishDescription: To protect and care for something or someone so that it or he/she is not put in a dangerous or difficult situation.
To accompany another person to protect and guard him/her.

sag.englishExpression: be dead tired; be subdued; sag
sag.englishDescription: For one's body to droop without energy.
To droop completely after using up all one's energy.

sag.definitionKo: 물체의 어느 부분이 가라앉거나 뭉툭한 상태가 되다.
sag.englishDescription: For a part of an object to sink or become blunt.

summons.definitionKo: 법원이나 검찰 등이 사건과 관련된 사람에게 오도록 명령하는 내용을 적은 문서.
summons.englishDescription: A document saying that the court, prosecution, etc., orders a person related to a case to come.

summons.definitionKo: 전화나 전신 등을 통해 상대방을 부르는 일.
summons.englishDescription: An act of calling someone to come by phone or telegraph.

supervise.definitionKo: 일이나 사람이 잘못되지 않도록 살피고 단속하다.
supervise.englishDescription: To monitor and enforce rules to promote work or to prevent those working from getting off task.

supervise.definitionKo: 공연, 영화, 운동 경기 등에서 일의 전체를 지휘하며 책임지다.
supervise.englishDescription: To direct the entire process of a work in a performance, movie, sports game, etc.

supervise.definitionKo: 단체의 규율과 구성원의 행동을 감독하여 살피다.
supervise.englishDescription: To supervise the discipline of a group and the behavior of its members.
To lead and superintend a person or people.
To be in charge of something.
To manage carefully so that things do not go wrong.

sushi.definitionKo: 주로 식초로 간을 한 밥을 작게 뭉쳐 생선, 달걀, 채소 등을 얹거나 싸서 만든 일본 음식.
sushi.englishDescription: A Japanese dish made by lumping boiled rice sprinkled with vinegar into bite-size pieces and placing fish, eggs, vegetables, etc., on top or using them as a wrapping.

sushi.definitionKo: 식초와 소금으로 간을 하여 작게 뭉친 흰밥에 생선을 얹거나 김, 유부 등으로 싸서 만든 일본 음식.
sushi.englishDescription: A Japanese dish made by placing fish on a small ball of rice seasoned with vinegar and salt, or by wrapping the rice ball with dried laver, fried tofu, etc.

sustain.definitionKo: 손해, 상처, 피해 등의 좋지 못한 일을 당하다.
sustain.englishDescription: To experience something bad, such as a loss, injury, damage, etc.

sustain.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 상태가 오래 계속되게 하다.
sustain.englishDescription: To make a certain act or state continue for a long time.
To speak or sing by stretching out the word or note.

swoosh.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of strong wind passing by.

tenant.definitionKo: 세를 내고 남의 집이나 방을 빌려 사는 사람.
tenant.englishDescription: Someone who pays rent to live in another person's house or room.

tenant.definitionKo: 일정한 구역에 업체나 가게, 시설 등이 들어가다.
tenant.englishDescription: For an enterprise, store, facility, etc., to occupy a certain area.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 끝내는 데 걸리는 기간이나 시간.
time.englishDescription: The period of time taken to finish a certain task.
A fixed time or date.
A certain single point in the continuous flow of time.
A period in which an event or phenomenon is in progress.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데에 알맞은 때나 적당한 기회.
time.englishDescription: The right time or appropriate opportunity of doing something.

time.definitionKo: 짐승이 새끼나 알을 낳는 횟수를 세는 단위.
time.englishDescription: The unit of counting the number of times an animal bears offspring or lays eggs.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 시간적인 틈이나 여유.
time.englishDescription: The time to do something.
The flow of time.
The duration of one's status or a certain era.
The passage of time.
The period between one point in time and another.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 시간적인 틈이나 여유.
time.englishDescription: Time or leisure to do something.
A unit for counting the number of times something happened.
The amount of time from one point to another.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하도록 정해진 때. 또는 하루 중의 어느 한 때.
time.englishDescription: A time when one is supposed to do something, or a particular time of day.
Spare time that one can use to do something.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 시작되어 끝날 때까지의 동안.
time.englishDescription: An interval from the time something starts to the time it ends.
Time that passes naturally.

time.definitionKo: 지금의 시기. 또는 문제가 되고 있는 그 시기.
time.englishDescription: The current age; the age that is currently being discussed.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하다가 생각을 돌리거나 다른 일에 마음을 기울일 수 있는 시간적 여유.
time.englishDescription: Time to spare for diverting one's thoughts or turning one's mind from one thing to another.
A certain moment or part of time.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 현상, 일 등이 일어나는 시간.
time.englishDescription: The time when a certain phenomenon or event occurs.
A state of being during a certain period.
A pre-determined time.
A pre-determined time or point in time.

time.definitionKo: 수영이나 육상 등에서, 정한 거리를 가는 데에 걸리는 시간.
time.englishDescription: In swimming or track and field, the time an athlete takes to finish a decided distance.

time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 만한 잠시 동안의 시간.
time.englishDescription: A bound noun indicating the short time during which one can do something.

toner.definitionKo: 복사기나 프린터에서 잉크 대신 사용하는 검은색 가루.
toner.englishDescription: Black powder used instead of ink in copiers and printers.

top-level.definitionKo: 어떤 것의 질에 있어서 가장 높은 등급.
top-level.englishDescription: The highest grade in the quality of something.

tortoise.definitionKo: 몸은 납작한 타원형이고 목이 짧으며, 등과 배에 단단한 껍질이 있어서 머리와 꼬리, 네 발을 그 안에 움츠려 넣을 수 있는 동물.
tortoise.englishDescription: An animal with a flat oval body, a short neck, and a hard shell on its back and stomach into which its head, tail, and four legs can be retracted.

tortoise.definitionKo: 몸은 납작한 타원형이고 목이 짧으며, 등과 배에 단단한 껍질이 있어서 머리와 꼬리, 네 발을 그 안에 움츠려 넣을 수 있는 동물.
tortoise.englishDescription: An animal with a flat oval body, a short neck, and a hard shell on its back and stomach into which its head, tail, and four legs can be retracted.

trailing.definitionKo: 감시하거나 증거를 잡기 위하여 남의 뒤를 몰래 따라감.
trailing.englishDescription: The act of secretly following someone in order to keep an eye on him/her or get evidence.

trailing.definitionKo: 아래로 길게 늘어진 천이나 물건이 부드럽게 처져 있다.
trailing.englishDescription: A cloth or object hung down swaying here and there smoothly and repeatedly.

transaction.englishDescription: The act of exchanging, selling or buying money or goods.
The act of selling and buying things.

transcribe.definitionKo: 음성으로 된 것을 글자로 옮겨 적다.
transcribe.englishDescription: To make a written copy of spoken material.
To make a written copy of a text or words, etc.

traverse.definitionKo: 양쪽 사이에 긴 물건을 가로로 놓거나 꽂다.
traverse.englishDescription: To place or insert a long object horizontally between two sides.

traverse.definitionKo: 어떤 공간의 가운데로 한 쪽 끝에서 다른 쪽 끝까지 놓이다.
traverse.englishDescription: To lie across a certain space from one end to another end.

traverse.definitionKo: 도로나 강 등을 가로 방향으로 지나다.
traverse.englishDescription: To go across a road or river.

traverse.definitionKo: 대륙이나 대양 등을 동서의 방향으로 가로로 건넘.
traverse.englishDescription: To cross a continent or an ocean horizontally in a direction from east to west.

tsk-tsk.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker scolds someone.

tsk-tsk.definitionKo: 아랫사람을 못마땅하게 여겨 꾸짖을 때 내는 소리.
tsk-tsk.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is dissatisfied with, and thus scolds, someone junior to him/her.

ttareum.englishDescription: A bound noun indicating there is nothing other that what was just mentioned.

tube.definitionKo: 둥근 모양으로 속이 빈, 길고 가느다란 막대.
tube.englishDescription: A long, slender, hollow object that is cylindrical in shape.

tube.definitionKo: 물이나 가스 등을 옮기는 데 쓰는, 속이 비어 있는 관.
tube.englishDescription: A cylinder, empty inside, which is used to carry water, gas, etc.

tube.definitionKo: 약이나 치약, 물감 등을 넣고 짜내어 쓰는 용기.
tube.englishDescription: A type of container holding medicine, toothpaste, paint, etc., which sends out the content when squeezed.

turbulence.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 결과를 예측할 수 없는 복잡하고 어려운 상황.
turbulence.englishDescription: (figurative) A complex, difficult situation that defies prediction.

turbulence.definitionKo: 사회의 상황이 매우 빠르고 급격하게 변함.
turbulence.englishDescription: A state in which the circumstances of a society change rapidly and dramatically.

two-dimensional.englishDescription: Taking or being in a flat form.

typeface.englishDescription: The style and size of printed characters.

unaffected.englishDescription: Being not affected, and thus not strange.

unaffected.definitionKo: 바뀌거나 달라지는 것이나 아무 사고 없이 온전하게.
unaffected.englishDescription: Intact, in perfect condition without having been affected by changes or accidents.

unblushingly.definitionKo: 쑥스러움이 없이 비위가 좋고 질긴 데가 있게.
unblushingly.englishDescription: In an impudent and tenacious manner without being too self-conscious.

undecided.englishDescription: A state of being undecided or unresolved.

uniformity.englishDescription: The state of being the same without difference.
The same nature or condition of something without variation.
A state in which a way or mindset of dealing with a certain work is uniform.

uniformity.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 여럿이 각각의 특성이 없이 모두 거의 비슷한 현상.
uniformity.englishDescription: (figurative) A phenomenon in which many things are similar to each other without any unique character.

uniformity.definitionKo: 모두가 하나와 같아서 다름이 없게 됨. 또는 모두가 하나와 같아서 다름이 없게 함.
uniformity.englishDescription: For everything to become identical without any differences; or to make everything look identical without any differences.

unsociable.englishDescription: A person's personality or attitude being not soft or generous.

usage.definitionKo: 무엇을 필요한 일이나 기능에 맞게 씀.
usage.englishDescription: An act of using something for a certain job or function.

usage.englishExpression: direction for use; instruction for use; usage
usage.englishDescription: A certain way of using something.

uvula.definitionKo: 목구멍 안쪽 끝의 위에서 아래로 내려온 둥그스름한 살.
uvula.englishDescription: A little, round-shaped mass of flesh hanging downward at the far end of one's throat.

vagrant.definitionKo: 일정하게 사는 곳과 하는 일 없이 떠돌아다니는 사람.
vagrant.englishDescription: A person who roams around without a home or a job.

waft.definitionKo: 냄새나 빛 같은 것이 가볍게 스쳐 지나가다.
waft.englishDescription: For a scent, light, etc., to pass someone or something lightly.

washing.englishDescription: The act of washing something clean.

washing.definitionKo: 더러운 옷이나 천 등을 물에 빠는 일.
washing.englishDescription: An act of washing dirty clothes, cloths, etc., in water.
An act of washing dirty clothes, etc.

wavingly.definitionKo: 넓은 강이나 바다의 물결이 파도를 이루어 아래위로 크게 흔들거리는 모양.
wavingly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of waves rolling on a lake or on the sea.

weasel.definitionKo: 어른 팔만한 크기의 누런 갈색 몸에 짧은 네 다리와 굵고 긴 꼬리를 가졌으며, 위험을 느끼면 고약한 냄새를 풍기는 동물.
weasel.englishDescription: A yellowish brown animal the size of an adult's arm which has four legs and a long, thick tail and gives out foul smell when it feels threatened.

weld.definitionKo: 두 개의 금속, 유리, 플라스틱 등을 녹여 서로 이어 붙이다.
weld.englishDescription: To connect two pieces of metal, glass, plastic, etc., by heating them.

whimsical.definitionKo: 말이나 행동, 감정 등이 이랬다저랬다 자주 변하는 데가 있다.
whimsical.englishDescription: Words, behavior, feelings, etc., often changing capriciously.

whimsical.definitionKo: 말이나 행동, 감정 등이 이랬다저랬다 자주 변하는 데가 있다.
whimsical.englishDescription: Words, behavior, feelings, etc., often changing capriciously.

workday.definitionKo: 직업을 가진 사람이 하루 동안 일하는 시간을 한 단위로 하여 이르는 말.
workday.englishDescription: A term referring to workers' daily working hours as a unit.

wreck.definitionKo: 폭풍우나 암초 등을 만나 부서지거나 뒤집힌 배.
wreck.englishDescription: A ship damaged because it has hit some rocks or has encountered a storm.

wreck.definitionKo: 물건을 못 쓰게 될 정도로 깨뜨리거나 망가뜨리다.
wreck.englishDescription: To break or ruin an object so that it cannot be used.

wreck.definitionKo: 부서지거나 망가져 못 쓰게 되어 남아 있는 물체.
거센 바람이나 파도를 만나거나, 바위나 빙산 등에 부딪쳐 배가 부서짐. 또는 그 배.
wreck.englishDescription: The state of a ship being broken during a storm, in raging waves, or against rocks or an iceberg, or such a broken ship.
To concentrate and think hard about different options.

yam.definitionKo: 껍질이 갈색 또는 붉은 색으로 속살은 노르스름하고 맛은 달면서 구수한, 식물의 뿌리.
yam.englishDescription: The root of a plant with a brown or red skin, with yellow insides which taste sweet and savory.

yam.definitionKo: 여름에 자주색 꽃이 피고 열매를 맺으며 뿌리를 식재료로 쓰는 풀.
yam.englishDescription: Grass that blooms purple flowers in summer, bears fruit, and whose roots are used as food.

year.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of years.

year.definitionKo: 학습 수준에 따라 일 년 단위로 구분한 학교 교육의 단계.
year.englishDescription: The stages of school education, each spanning one year, divided according to level of learning.

year.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 일어난 시기를 말하기 위해 편의상 구분한 일 년의 기간.
year.englishDescription: A period of one year, a time unit created for convenience in order to refer to the time of an occurrence.

year.definitionKo: 지구가 태양을 한 바퀴 도는 동안. 한 해는 열두 달이다.
year.englishDescription: The time during which the earth rotates around the sun once.

year.definitionKo: 일 년을 단위로 돌아오는 해를 세는 단위.
year.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting a recurring period that spans a year.

zymotechnics.definitionKo: 효모나 미생물을 이용하여 유기물을 분해하고 변화시키는 방법.
zymotechnics.englishDescription: A method of using yeast or microorganisms to decompose and alter an organic matter.
